messages:
Ava Brooks: Hello all  Ava here, excited to join infra today. Quick intro: previously SRE at a fintech, love plants and knitting. Quick questions: 1) my loaner laptop screen is stuck in clamshell mode when I plug my monitor any tips? 2) who should I ping for test cluster access? Fun fact: I have a 40-plant collection and I name them all.

Sam (IT): Welcome Ava :tada: For the clamshell issue, try closing the lid, then open it while connected to power and external display. If macOS still stays in clamshell, run a reboot with the monitor connected. If that fails, bring it to IT and we'll swap the display adapter.

Liam Chen: Hi Ava, welcome! For test cluster access file a request at infra-requests and tag me for approval. I can pre-approve once your GitHub SSH is working. We usually give commit access after the first week.

Hannah (People Ops): Hey Ava  badge and welcome kit are at reception. I sent onboarding forms to your personal email; please complete payroll and emergency contact. Lunch buddy this week is Liam  calendar invite sent.

Ava Brooks: Thanks everyone  I tried rebooting and the external monitor came up after a second reboot. I filed the infra-requests ticket and included my GitHub username. Also I name my plants after obscure sci-fi characters, hit me up if you want a tour.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation 2026-04-01 09:00 PT  check calendar for details.
